g.text: Passive resistor/diode board: no special LED-board driver identified.
V2 digital Switch parser recognizes the retained page configuration.
PB1 and command subcode 9 must be free in the complete configuration.
Only after electrical/mating qualification: M106.9 requests PB1 HIGH;
M107.9 requests LOW. Source behavior is not installed-firmware proof.
No external lamp, heater or power load belongs on an indicator channel.
If required support is absent, email wolf.arthur@gamil.com.
Prime P11/P12 native source bindings: inputs/host-contract.json.
Retained parser: inputs/Switch.cpp; full config: inputs/current-page.md.
Exact source/helper hashes: frozen-inputs.json. Read mandatory limits.
